issues.description: The problem statement requires Bookstore to have an initializer with the signature init(books: [Book]). In the solution implementation, Bookstore defines init() with no parameters and attempts to assign self.books = books (an undefined identifier). This contradicts the specified constructor and also conflicts with the Client implementation, which calls Bookstore(books: books). As a result, students following the solution would encounter a compilation error and confusion about the required constructor signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Bookstore initializer in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift to match the specification and usage: init(books: [Book]) { self.books = books }. Ensure the parameter name and type match the problem statement so Client can construct a Bookstore with Bookstore(books: books).
